jobAnalysis.description: Analyze each position from an existing document or a guided questionnaire, then approve it. Approved analyses drive KPIs and task matching.
jobAnalysis.positionDescription: Review the AI draft, edit anything that is off, then approve.
jobAnalysis.progress: {{approved}} of {{total}} positions have an approved analysis.
jobAnalysis.uploadHint: Upload an existing job analysis or job description. Claude reads it and drafts a structured analysis for you to review. Nothing is approved automatically.
jobAnalysis.fileHint: PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), text or image, up to 20 MB.
jobAnalysis.tooLarge: The file must be 20 MB or smaller.
jobAnalysis.startHint: The standard job analysis questionnaire. Claude can ask follow-up questions, then draft the analysis from the answers.
jobAnalysis.respondentHint: Usually the person in the position or their manager. They will see it on their dashboard.
jobAnalysis.attachJdHint: Used as reference alongside the answers.
jobAnalysis.emptyPosition: No analysis yet. Upload a document, start a questionnaire, or write one manually.
jobAnalysis.confirmApprove: Approve this version? It becomes the active analysis for this position and can no longer be edited.
jobAnalysis.needCoreKeyword: Add at least one core keyword before approving.
jobAnalysis.weightsHint: Weights are rebalanced to total 100% when you save.
jobAnalysis.keywordsHint: Words employees write in timesheets when doing this job, in English and Arabic. Core keywords show work on the job's main purpose; ancillary keywords show supporting work. Used for the Task Alignment Index.
jobAnalysis.addKeyword: Type a keyword and press Enter
jobAnalysis.questionnaireHint: Answer in your own words, in English or Arabic. You can save and come back later.
jobAnalysis.noMoreFollowUps: The AI has no further questions.
jobAnalysis.confirmSubmit: Submit your answers? You will not be able to change them afterwards.
jobAnalysis.sessionClosed: This questionnaire is closed and can no longer be edited.
jobAnalysis.myBody: HR asked you to describe your job. It takes about 15 minutes.
